title: Effectiveness of High-rise Littering Prevention Measures
what_it_is: Effectiveness of High-rise Littering Prevention Measures

sections.label: NEA high-rise littering reports
sections.summary: In 2015, NEA received about 2,800 reports of high-rise littering.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In 2015, the National Environment Agency (NEA) received some 2,800 reports of high-rise littering.

sections.label: Killer litter arrests and reports
sections.summary: In 2015, two persons were arrested for killer litter causing hurt, and SPF received no reports of death from killer litter.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In addition to the reports received by NEA, SPF's records showed that in 2015, two persons were arrested for throwing killer litter which resulted in hurt.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: SPF did not receive any reports of death from killer litter in 2015.

sections.label: NEA enforcement actions against litterbugs
sections.summary: Last year, NEA took over 800 enforcement actions against high-rise litterbugs, an 80-fold increase from 2011 before surveillance cameras.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Last year, NEA took more than 800 enforcement actions against high-rise litterbugs, an 80-fold increase compared to 2011, when the surveillance cameras had not been introduced yet.

sections.label: Camera deployments increased
sections.summary: Camera deployments were increased more than four times to close to 3,000 over the last three years in response to rising high-rise littering feedback.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In response to the rising number of high-rise littering feedback, we have done a number of things.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have increased the number of camera deployments by more than four times to close to 3,000 over the last three years.

sections.label: Camera deployment time
sections.summary: Upon confirmation of the need to deploy a camera, it can normally be installed as soon as four days from confirmation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the time required to deploy a camera, normally, upon confirmation of the need to deploy a camera, we can install it as soon as four days from the date of confirmation.

sections.label: Camera success rate
sections.summary: Based on the number of camera deployments, the overall success rate in identifying perpetrators is about one-third.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding the success rate of the cameras in identifying perpetrators, on the whole, based on the number of camera deployments, it is about one-third.

sections.label: Name-and-shame tactic monitoring
sections.summary: The speaker says the name-and-shame tactic will continue to be monitored and considered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding a "name-and-shame" tactic, I think it is something we will continue to monitor and consider.
